import os,re,json,datetime

add='\n\nAdditional S7 checks / S7 追加核对: [Historical Git snapshot hashes and non-overlapping response ownership](steps/S7/historical-source-and-accounting-audit.json), [Original browser JSON and raw trace POST/GET same record](steps/S7/raw-test-trace-audit.json).  p=E/n;s=p.read_text();pos=s.index('<!-- S7-LIVE-USAGE -->');s=s[:pos].rstrip()+add+'\n'+s[pos:];p.write_text(s)
 text=re.sub(r'\]\(([^)]+)\)',lambda m: ']('+os.path.relpath((E/m.group(1)).resolve(),D.resolve())+')',s)
 (D/n).write_text(text+'\n\nCommitted report is a pre-final snapshot. Terminal collector updates external summaries/USAGE/manifests; no automatic Git commit.\n提交为回复前快照，终端更新外部用量摘要与 manifest，不自动提交。\n')

No new experiments; final S7 provider coverage pending external finalize.'),ensure_ascii=False)+'\n')
with (E/'EVIDENCE_INDEX.md').open('a') as f:f.write('\n- [Historical snapshot/accounting audit](steps/S7/historical-source-and-accounting-audit.json)\n- [Raw test and trace audit](steps/S7/raw-test-trace-audit.json)\n')
